about: Pinned starter threads, one per forum, written by the site itself (shown as OpenVibe). server/forum/starters.js syncs this file at every boot: a new key becomes a pinned thread, a changed title or body updates it in place.

items.title: Welcome to OpenVibe: start here
items.body:
OpenVibe is a network of open-source sites that share one account. Sign in once at [openvibe.network](https://openvibe.network) and the same name, avatar and followers work everywhere.

A few places to start:

- **[OpenVibe.Live](https://openvibe.live)**: go live straight from your browser, with no OBS and no follower minimum. [How it works](https://openvibe.live/docs/go-live-in-your-browser).
- **[OpenVibe.Tools](https://openvibe.tools)**: free tools that work in the browser: converters, PDF, images, text and developer tools.
- **[OpenVibe.Games](https://openvibe.games)**: games to play, creator worlds and what is on Steam right now.
- **[OpenVibe.Space](https://openvibe.space)**: make your own site and publish it.
- **[OpenVibe.Help](https://openvibe.help)**: answers about every site, and tickets when you need a person.

This forum is for anything about OpenVibe and the people on it. Introduce yourself, ask what something does, or tell us what you are making.

Ideas and bugs go in [Feedback](/s/feedback), where people vote on them. What we are building next is on the [Roadmap](/s/roadmap). Everything here follows the [terms](/terms).

items.title: How to get help (read this first)
items.body:
Ask anything here: streaming, tools, your account, any OpenVibe site. Other people and staff answer in the thread, so the next person with the same question finds it.

A question gets answered faster when it says:

- **Which site and page**, with its link.
- **What you did**, step by step.
- **What you expected, and what happened instead.** Copy any error message exactly.
- **Your device and browser**, for example "Android, Chrome" or "Windows, Firefox".

Never post a password, a stream key, an API token or a sign-in link. Nobody from OpenVibe will ask you for one.

Other places to look:

- [OpenVibe.Help](https://openvibe.help) searches every site's answers, and you can open a private ticket there for account or payment problems.
- [Network status](https://openvibe.network/status) shows whether a site is having trouble right now.
- Going live: [the guide to streaming from your browser](https://openvibe.live/docs/go-live-in-your-browser).

When your question is answered, say what fixed it. It helps the next person.

items.title: How feedback works
items.body:
This is where ideas, bugs and questions about every OpenVibe site go. Posts are ranked by votes, so what most people want rises to the top.

- **One idea or one bug per post.** Search first: if it is already here, vote for it and add what is different for you.
- **Pick a category** (idea, bug or question) when you post.
- **For a bug**, say which site and page, what you did, what you expected and what happened. A screenshot helps.
- **For an idea**, say what you are trying to do. The problem matters more than the exact solution.

Staff mark each post as **planned**, **in progress**, **done** or **declined**, and the status shows on the post. Bigger pieces of work go on the [Roadmap](/s/roadmap), where every item has its own thread.

Security problems should not be posted in public. Open a private ticket at [OpenVibe.Help](https://openvibe.help) instead.

items.title: Show what you made
items.body:
This forum is for your work: streams, clips, art, music, code, tools, game worlds and sites. Things made with OpenVibe and things made elsewhere are both welcome.

A good showcase post:

- **Links to it**: your channel on [OpenVibe.Live](https://openvibe.live), a world on [OpenVibe.Games](https://openvibe.games/worlds), a site you published on [OpenVibe.Space](https://openvibe.space), or anywhere else.
- **Says what it is and how you made it.** People like to know the tools and the story.
- **Credits the people and sources you used.**

Posts are ranked by votes. Only post work that is yours or that you have permission to share.

items.title: Off-topic: house rules
items.body:
Anything that is not about OpenVibe goes here: games, music, what you are watching, your day.

The same few rules apply as everywhere on OpenVibe:

- Be kind. Argue with ideas, not with people.
- No spam, ads or link farming.
- No threats, and nobody's private information.
- Nothing illegal, nothing you do not have the rights to, and mark adult content as adult.

If a post breaks them, tell staff with a private ticket at [OpenVibe.Help](https://openvibe.help). The full rules are in the [terms](/terms).
